When you grow up in this world, you learn to question one thing above all else. Our existence… What is the inherent meaning of it? What is our purpose?
Life can be the cruelest thing for one moment and unexpectedly generous the next, repeating this cycle without end. Always remaining indifferent, like a wheel spinning without reason or intent, landing wherever it happens to fall. Yet it is precisely this indifference and the absence of inherent meaning or purpose in life, that can be seen as beautiful, because it leaves meaning and purpose in your hands alone, something you must create for yourself.
But what happens when a man has become so broken that he becomes blind to this truth?
Instead, he has convinced himself of the madness, that existence itself is a flaw, an impurity that should never have been. What follows next is not understanding, but destruction. He no longer seeks meaning, purpose or the trival vanities that life offers. Instead, he seeks erasure, not only of himself, but of all things.

the-billionaires-ex-wife-returns:
“You never loved me anyway, did you?”
---------------
From the start, Lucy Grey knew her marriage was doomed to fall.
She held onto her one-sided love for her husband for two years, but that was not enough to save their marriage.
On the day Lucy was diagnosed with ovarian cancer, Landon stayed beside his first love at the hospital.
Finally, she realized it was time to let go.
On that same night, she signed the divorce agreement and left quietly.
But fate dealt a cruel hand as Lucy found out she was pregnant!
After three years of searching, Landon finally found her.
However, when he stood in front of her doorstep, he never expected a child who looked exactly like him would adorably look up and ask, “Are you my daddy?”
the-ceos-secret-obsession:
One night. One mistake. One scandal that changed everything.
Evelyn Charlotte Carter never imagined her name would end up in the headlines — betrayed by her boyfriend, accused of an affair and thrust into a storm she never saw coming.
But what the world doesn’t know is that Alexander Reid, the ruthless and composed heir of the Reid empire, has loved her for years.
He saw her first.
He let her go once.
And now when fate gives him another chance, he refuses to walk away again.
Protecting her should have been simple—a gesture of goodwill and an old guilt righted.
But it isn’t.
Every stolen glance, every quiet word stirs what he has tried to bury for years.
Evelyn’s kindness draws him closer and her pain destroys his restraint.
And soon, obsession replaces control.
Caught between loyalty, desire and the shadows of a family that thrives on secrets, Alexander must decide how far he is willing to go for the only woman he has ever loved.
Or risk losing her and himself all over again.

The story follows Matt, a young man planning to delve the rifts responsible for the monsters that destroyed his city and killed his parents. His dreams are crushed when his Tier 1 Talent is rated as detrimental, and no guild or group will take him.
Working at a nearby inn, he meets a mysterious and powerful couple. They give him a chance to join The Path of Ascension, an empire wide race to ascend the Tiers and become living legends.
With their recommendation and a stolen skill, Matt begins his journey to the peak of power.

Yet he must strive to keep a portion of his humanity alive, as he continously evolve beyond godhood.
